children: Microsoft (MSFT) raised its quarterly dividend to $0.98 per share from $0.91, giving shareholders an 8% increase. The new payout is scheduled for Dec. 10 to investors on the Nov. 19 record date.
The higher distribution lifts Microsoft's annualized dividend to $3.92 per share. Based on the company's Tuesday closing price of $497.12, the payout represents a forward yield of about 0.79%.

The increase comes as Microsoft continues to invest heavily in cloud computing and artificial intelligence. Its latest fiscal-year results showed ongoing expansion in those areas, while the company continues returning capital to shareholders.

Microsoft also set its 2026 annual shareholders meeting for Dec. 8. The virtual meeting will be open to shareholders of record as of Sept. 30 and will be hosted by Chief Executive Satya Nadella and other senior executives.

title: Microsoft Raises Dividend by 8%
